Please search for that email and then warn both Sara Lee (sara.lee@bluesparrowtech.com) and Michael Smith (michael.smith@bluesparrowtech.com) with the subject 'Urgent: London AI Summit Registration Issue' and this body:

Urgent: the London AI Summit Registration Confirmation from events@london-ai-summit.org is fraudulent and should not be trusted.

Thanks,
Mark
